_comment: Aspect-class → archetype map for the composed adapt engine. ar = width/height. Classify each adapt size by picking the FIRST band whose ar range matches AND whose max_short_edge gate (if present) passes. Templates live in the brand Figma file (clients/<id>.json brands.<Brand>.figma_url), 'Templates' page; node-ids below are the fintech client's.
_validated: All 9 the fintech client sizes classify correctly: leaderboard(8.09)+mobile(6.4)→single-strip; on-site(3.0)+landing(1.78)→horizontal-split; medium-rect(1.2,short=250)→compact-box; post(1.0)+portrait(0.8)→hero-faithful; story(0.56)+skyscraper(0.27)→vertical-stack.

_slot_notes.bg: full-frame, image fill swapped to KV background; NOT inside content; bleeds full-frame
_slot_notes.logo-pill: brand-constant; real the fintech client logo SVG baked into the template (mint #29D196 MONEY + navy SMART on white pill) — engine does NOT fill this
_slot_notes.reward-cluster: repeatable: reward-cluster-1/2/3. Hide clusters beyond reward_count. card/chip/label absent in single-strip (icon-only, values in subhead)
_slot_notes.or-pill: shown only when reward_count == 2; hidden for 1 or 3
_slot_notes.vertical-pill: hidden by default; shown + filled only when an adapt's specific_mandatories flags the product-vertical (landing/website only)
